results.overview:
MegaTokyo 2038: A.D. Police Officer Kenji Sasaki loses another partner to a rabid boomer.

A day after he's sent off-duty, he receives a new partner: German cop Hans Kleif.
results.name: A.D. Police

results.overview:
MegaTokyo 2027: Relentless technological development has resulted in the creation of Boomers.

These are artificially intelligent androids with the potential to free mankind from physical labor; but anything that can be used can also be misused.
results.name: A.D. Police Files

results.overview: When upright cop Arjun Maitra takes on Kolkata's feared don Bagha and his henchmen, he must battle a broken system and navigate bloody gang wars.
results.name: Khakee: The Bengal Chapter

results.overview: As a righteous cop pursues a merciless criminal in Bihar, he finds himself navigating a deadly chase and a moral battle mired in corruption.
results.name: Khakee: The Bihar Chapter

results.original_name: 警視庁 特務部 特殊凶悪犯対策室 第七課 -トクナナ-
results.overview: Set in a different Tokyo on a different world than ours, the story follows Tokunana, a unit of assembled misfits in the Metropolitan Police Department. Tokunana battles against "Nine" — an organization commiting crimes in their zealous worship of the dragons that once roamed the world.
results.name: Special 7: Special Crime Investigation Unit
